nodes.summary: Let $A$, $B$, $C$ be discrete valuation rings, with $B$ and $C$ finite $A$-algebras whose structure maps are local homomorphisms, $B$ étale over $A$, and $C$ a Henselian local ring. Write $\kappa(R)$ for the residue field of a local ring $R$. Then sending an $A$-algebra homomorphism $B \to C$ to the $\kappa(A)$-algebra homomorphism $\kappa(B) \to \kappa(C)$ it induces is a bijection.
